description:
Surfaced during Arc 65 (stoa--z2b) VERA verdict; confirmed by CATO (c2 follow-up) + floor-manager.

GAP: save-verdict's --threat-coverage-probe-ids mechanical check uses a regex anchored to lowercase '^p' (e.g. ^p[0-9]+). Design probes throughout the substrate are named UPPERCASE P1..P11 (CAPTAIN_DAEDALUS probe convention). To satisfy the mechanical check, VERA had to pass the lowercase ALIAS 'p2' while the verdict body's defeats_via_probe + probes_executed use 'P2'. 

WHY IT MATTERS: the check exists to enforce defeats_via_probe is in probes_executed (the §4.3.2 / op-disc §35.5 threat-coverage binding). If the tool accepts a lowercase 'p2' arg that need NOT case-match the body's uppercase 'P2', the mechanical enforcement is satisfiable by a string that doesn't actually match the cited probe id — an integrity gap. Today it is benign (VERA's body correctly cites P2 and seat-side grep confirmed P2 in probes_executed), but the mechanical check is meant to be the backstop precisely so a future verdict can't claim a binding that isn't there.

FIX PLAN (concrete): make the save-verdict probe-id regex case-INSENSITIVE (^[Pp][0-9]+) OR normalize both the --threat-coverage-probe-ids arg and the parsed probes_executed ids to a common case before the membership check, so the mechanical assert compares the SAME normalized id the body uses. Add a test: a verdict whose defeats_via_probe=P2 + probes_executed=[P2] passes WITHOUT requiring a lowercase alias; a verdict whose defeats_via_probe=P9 but probes_executed lacks P9 FAILS regardless of case. NEXT ACTION: locate the regex in the save-verdict skill module (substrate/skills/save-verdict/) and the §-anchored check; fix + test.

Pre-existing (not Arc-65-introduced); out of Arc-65 scope. Severity: the binding is currently sound for z2b, but the enforcement integrity should be fixed before a future verdict relies on it.
